sources.title: Fusion CX IPO: Rs 700-800 Cr Launch Expected Next Week
Fusion CX cuts IPO size to ₹702 crore; eyes ₹120-crore pre-IPO placement

synopsis: AI-powered customer experience solutions provider Fusion CX expects to launch an initial public offering valued around Rs 700-800 crore as early as next week, down from an earlier planned Rs 1,000 crore. The proposed IPO comprises a fresh issue of equity shares and an Offer for Sale by existing shareholders. Proceeds from the fresh issue will be directed toward debt repayment, investment in subsidiaries Omind Technologies Inc and Omind Technologies Pvt Ltd for IT upgrades, acquisitions, and general corporate purposes. The Kolkata-headquartered company reported a net profit of Rs 170 crore for FY26 on revenues of Rs 1,818 crore. Nuvama Wealth Management, IIFL Capital Services, and Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors are serving as the book-running lead managers for the issue.
